title: Baby Booties
description: Soft small booties that practice shaping a sole, building sides, and closing a neat toe.
expectationText: A compact baby project that helps you understand how a flat sole turns into a three-dimensional wearable shape.

steps.title: Make the sole
steps.instruction: Chain the base length and work an oval sole with increases at both ends.

steps.title: Build the sides
steps.instruction: Work even rounds around the sole so the fabric starts to bend upward.

steps.title: Shape the toe
steps.instruction: Decrease across the front section to round the toe without collapsing the heel area.

steps.title: Create the opening and cuff
steps.instruction: Work short even rounds or rows to define the ankle opening and make a soft cuff.

steps.title: Repeat for the second bootie
steps.instruction: Count carefully so the second bootie matches the first in length, toe depth, and cuff height.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in the ends securely and gently shape both booties so the pair looks even.
